storeFirstParagraph: Sanguine helps you track and understand your menstrual cycle. It is not a contraceptive and is not a medical device.
onboardingPurpose: Sanguine estimates when your next period and your ovulation are likely, using what you log. Estimates are ranges, not promises.
estimateCard: Estimated ovulation around {point} (range {lo}–{hi}). This is for understanding your cycle. Do not use it to prevent pregnancy.
aboutDisclaimer: Sanguine does not diagnose, screen for or treat any condition. If you are worried about your health, talk to a health professional.
footer: Estimates are ranges, not promises. Not a contraceptive.
intendedPurpose: Track and understand your menstrual cycle.
notMedicalDevice: Sanguine is not a contraceptive and is not a medical device.
privacyThreeSentences: Everything you log stays on this phone, encrypted. Sanguine has no account and no server; we cannot see your data and cannot hand it to anyone. Backups, if you turn them on, are encrypted before they reach your iCloud or Google Drive.
healthStoreNotice: Anything written to {store} is governed by {platform}'s privacy rules and is visible to other apps you have allowed.
collectionNotice: Sanguine collects nothing. What you log is stored on this phone. You can export or delete all of it at any time in Settings.
